about: What the screenshot gallery should show. capture.mjs reads this, writes shots/<id>/<theme>-<width>.png, and updates each entry's status. Screens are captured against the deterministic mock API (ui/scripts/e2e-api.mjs), never a real Worlds: this repo is public.

entries.title: Bridge (home)
entries.caption: Home: your guide's briefing, what needs you, and each room as a doorway.
entries.alt: The Bridge: a short briefing at the top, a Needs you tray, and room doorway cards with their status in words.

entries.title: A room's drawer (Studio)
entries.caption: Look inside a room: its status in words, what changed, and what needs you. Links open on the room's own site.
entries.alt: The Studio drawer open beside the Bridge, showing a need, cards with tone words, and an Open Studio button.

entries.title: Workshop drawer with Secrets
entries.caption: The Workshop's Secrets section, for the owner only: key names and health, never a value.
entries.alt: The Workshop drawer with a Secrets section: the station's health in words and key names in groups.

entries.title: Secrets: waiting for you
entries.caption: An agent asked for a secret. Nothing is shared until you type it on Project Home's page.
entries.alt: The Workshop drawer's Secrets section with a request card and an Enter it in Project Home button.

entries.title: A room Worlds can't reach
entries.caption: A room that isn't answering says so and when it last answered. Nothing from it is shown as current.
entries.alt: The Cellar drawer saying Worlds can't reach it and when it last answered.

entries.title: Find a room (12 or more rooms)
entries.caption: With 12 or more rooms, a search box appears and says how many rooms match.
entries.alt: The Rooms section with a Find a room box containing 'st' and a line saying how many rooms match.

entries.title: No rooms yet
entries.caption: Before any room is connected, the Bridge says so and explains how rooms connect.
entries.alt: The Rooms section saying there are no rooms yet, with a How rooms connect button.

entries.title: Ask about a room in Chat
entries.caption: Ask about a room: Chat opens with a question already written in the box. You send it.
entries.alt: The Chat screen with a question about Studio written in the message box, not yet sent.

entries.title: Memory
entries.caption: Memory: your journal and records, and finding things in them.
entries.alt: The Memory screen with a note box and recent journal entries.

entries.title: Chat
entries.caption: Chat with your companion. It can look things up; anything it wants to change becomes a proposal you approve.
entries.alt: The Chat screen with the companion's name in the header and the message box.

entries.title: Settings
entries.caption: Settings: your crew, messages, look and feel, and more.
entries.alt: The Settings screen with the Your crew card, message choices and theme swatches.

entries.title: Crew
entries.caption: Crew: choose your companion, and put a keeper and a doorway on each room.
entries.alt: The Crew page with companion cards and a keeper and doorway choice for each room.
entries.notes: If the Settings screen's way into Crew has a different accessible name, fix the step, not the UI.

entries.title: People
entries.caption: People: who lives in this World, each role written as what that person can do, inviting someone, and handing the World over.
entries.alt: The People page listing Sam, Jo, Alex, Robin and Kit, each with a plain sentence about what they can do.

entries.title: Let someone help you
entries.caption: Let someone help you: choose who and for how long, stop it any time, and see what they did.
entries.alt: The helpers page with a form to choose a person and how long, a list of who is helping now with Stop now buttons, and a Who helped me list.

entries.title: Interests (moving to Candy)
entries.caption: Interests: discovery as it lives in Worlds today, before it moves to the Candy room.
entries.alt: The Interests screen with a list of followed interests.

entries.title: Projects (Hive Works not connected)
entries.caption: Projects shows the Hive Works company. When Hive Works isn't connected, the page says so instead of showing anything as current.
entries.alt: The Projects page saying Hive Works isn't connected to this World yet.

entries.title: First Light: welcome
entries.caption: First Light, the first-run setup, starts with a plain welcome.
entries.alt: The First Light welcome step with a Let's begin button.

entries.title: First Light: make yourself comfortable
entries.caption: Choose a theme, larger text, gentle motion, and whether the crew is on.
entries.alt: The First Light comfort step with three theme choices and three checkboxes.

entries.title: First Light: pick a companion
entries.caption: Pick a companion, or keep the Assistant's plain voice.
entries.alt: The First Light companion step with the Assistant chosen.

entries.title: Sign in
entries.caption: Sign in to Worlds. With an identity provider set up, a passkey comes first and the access code is the fallback.
entries.alt: The Worlds sign-in page with a field for the access code.
